runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist who needs luck in running from the back in this competitive field.

runners_data.name: Almarada Prince
runners_data.note: Another hold-up horse who must hope the pace is strong enough to bring him into contention.

runners_data.name: Tiriac
runners_data.note: Sits off the pace and could benefit if the prominent runners neutralize each other early.

runners_data.name: Havana Blast
runners_data.note: Needs good going conditions but has the class to win if getting the right trip from behind.

runners_data.name: Sports Coach
runners_data.note: Key player in the prominent pack with going concerns but tactical speed to strike first.

runners_data.name: Station X
runners_data.note: The lone leader who must judge the pace perfectly to avoid being swamped late.

runners_data.name: Master Of My Fate
runners_data.note: Dangerous from prominent position if handling conditions, has the rating to win this.

runners_data.name: Blinky
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose chances depend entirely on the going and finding racing room late.

runners_data.name: Vingegaard
runners_data.note: Strong from the back if the pace sets up right, proven at this trip.

runners_data.name: Reigning Profit
runners_data.note: Sits prominent and could benefit from being slightly less forward than the main pace brigade.

runners_data.name: Mon Na Slieve
runners_data.note: Another in the crowded prominent group who needs to avoid traffic problems.

runners_data.name: Kinetic Force
runners_data.note: Going-dependent runner who sits handy but may struggle on this surface.

races.paceDynamic: Station X will set the pace alone early, creating a sustainable tempo that should hold through halfway. Sports Coach, Master Of My Fate, Reigning Profit, Mon Na Slieve and Kinetic Force will create significant congestion in prominent positions, leading to traffic problems and checking 2-3 furlongs out as they fan across the track seeking racing room.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Station X Wire Job
scenarios.trigger: If Station X gets soft fractions and the prominent brigade get in each other's way
scenarios.body: The leader kicks clear turning for home while the prominent horses are still sorting themselves out. The hold-up horses have too much to do from the back in a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Power Play
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners settle better than expected and one gets first run
scenarios.body: Sports Coach or Master Of My Fate uses their class to strike first from the pack, with Station X vulnerable late. The winner comes from that congested prominent group finding daylight.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Hero
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses into a sprint and the back markers get splits
scenarios.body: Vingegaard or Havana Blast storm home through gaps as the early pace becomes unsustainable. The leaders and prominent runners tie up in the final furlong after going too fast early.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Station X goes too fast trying to shake off the prominent brigade
scenarios.body: The whole field comes together in a blanket finish with any of the 12 capable of winning. Multiple hard-luck stories emerge from the scrimmaging throughout the field.

watchPoints.text: Station X must be monitored early to see if the prominent runners let him coast or force him into a speed duel
The prominent quintet of Sports Coach, Master Of My Fate, Reigning Profit, Mon Na Slieve and Kinetic Force for traffic problems approaching the final two furlongs
Going-dependent runners Havana Blast, Sports Coach, Master Of My Fate, Blinky and Kinetic Force if conditions deteriorate
Hold-up horses Vingegaard, Havana Blast and Blinky need to be positioned within striking distance turning for home
Reigning Profit could be the best-positioned prominent runner if staying slightly wider than the main pack
